description: TwingateCertificateAuthority represents a Certificate Authority in Twingate.

spec.description: TwingateCertificateAuthoritySpec defines the desired state of TwingateCertificateAuthority

name.description: Name used at creation if the Certificate Authority doesn't exist yet in Twingate.

secretRef.description: Reference to the kubernetes.io/tls Secret the CA's public certificate (ca.crt) is read from.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret object. Defaults to the TwingateCertificateAuthority's own namespace when omitted.

type.description: Type of the Certificate Authority. Only X509 is currently supported.
